name: careclaim
description: CareClaim: frontend + middleware + backend in one repo

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix middleware install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,middleware,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix middleware run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix middleware exec tsc -- --noEmit && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix middleware run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
